items.title: Inflation surges more than expected ahead of RBA meeting
items.summary: Australia's inflation rate picked up more than expected in September, increasing expectations of an interest rate hike next week.

items.title: Fed Rate-Hike Odds Slip As Warsh Notes Tighter AI Financing
items.summary: Policymakers voted 10-2 on Wednesday to keep rates unchanged. Fed chief Kevin Warsh has finished speaking.

items.title: America's largest budget airline reports 71% jump in airfare
items.summary: Frontier Airlines reported a 71% jump in airfare for the third quarter and said customers continue to book

aus.headline: Inflation Runs Hotter Than Expected
aus.body: Price growth in Australia sped up by more than tipped in September.
aus.why: It lifts the odds of an RBA rate hike next week.

us.headline: Fed Holds Rates In Split Vote
us.body: The US Fed left rates on hold, with policymakers voting 10-2.
us.why: US rate calls sway the Aussie dollar and global markets.

biz.headline: Frontier Airfares Up 71%
biz.body: Budget carrier Frontier Airlines said its airfare rose 71% in the third quarter.
biz.why: A sign US travellers are still paying up to fly.
